name: bb-plugin-makosh-commander

bb.name: Makosh Commander [Experimental]
bb.description: Two-pane file manager for local files and SFTP: copy, sync, search, batch rename, archive extract, F4 edit, job queue, CLI and agent tools.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.build:helper: RUSTFLAGS="--remap-path-prefix=$HOME=/home/builder --remap-path-prefix=$PWD=/src $RUSTFLAGS" cargo build --release --locked --target aarch64-apple-darwin --manifest-path helper/Cargo.toml && mkdir -p bin && cp helper/target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/commander-archive-helper bin/commander-archive-helper && chmod +x bin/commander-archive-helper && node scripts/helper-sums.mjs

description: Two-pane file manager for local files and SFTP: copy, sync, search, batch rename, archive extract, F4 edit, job queue, CLI and agent tools.
